page.overview:
What is Munkidori?

Munkidori is a primarily black and white Pokémon with a toxic chain around its head. It has apparently been enhanced by its chain. Otherwise, he has a relatively tube shaped body, with a bulbous head and has a slightly hunched physique.

Munkidori is shown to be lazy, rude, and apathetic. It takes the time to bully Ogerpon alongside the other members of the "loyal" three. It's also said that it likes to toy with its enemies before beating them.

Most, if not all, of these abilities are caused by the toxic chain. It has been observed to have enhanced brainpower and poison its enemies via attack.

Munkidori, along with Ogerpon, Okidogi, Fezandipiti, and Pecharunt, are based on the creatures of the Japanese folktale; Momotarō. Munkidori specifically represents the monkey of the folktale. Munkidori also resembles a Japanese macaque, specifically the ones residing in the . This is reflected with its Shiny form, which gives it a slight tanned fur coat. Symbolically, it is said the animals that accompany Momotaro are holy animals, where the monkey is associated with demon quelling and hunting monkey kami, due to its Japanese namesake sharing the homophone for "to expel", specifically in the case of unwarranted visitors and demons.
